ranked.explanation: Cerro looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 108 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 79/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Expect: it can feel softer or less defined than the main peaks, and rocks may appear closer to the west cliffs.
